sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 18, Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Eleventh Amendment) Order 1985
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 18 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
18 OF 1985
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (ELEVENTH AMENDMENT) ORDER,
1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan. Extraordinary, Part I, 17th March, 1985]
No. F. 17(3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
In pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following
Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) (Eleventh Amendment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 10, P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.--In the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], hereinafter
referred to as the said Order, in Article 10, in clause (2), in paragraph (b),-
(a) in sub-paragraph (9), for the
full stop at the end the semicolon and word " ; or"'shall be
substituted ; and
(b) after sub-paragraph (9), amended as aforesaid, the following new
sub-paragraph shall be inserted, namely :-
"(10) he is
the husband or she is the wife, or a dependant son or daughter, of a person who
holds any office of profit in the service of Pakistan other than an office
specified in sub-paragraph (9)."
3 Election of certain persons void.--The election of any
person such as is referred to in sub-paragraph (10) of paragraph (b) of clause
(2) of Article 10 of the said Order that may have been declared before the com mencement
of the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Eleventh
Amendment) Order, 1985, shall be, and shall be deemed always to have been,
void.
